1.3.0.en:
* Adapter requires js-controller >= 6.0.11 now.
* Adapter requires node.js >= 22 now
* Adapter requires node.js >= 20 now.
* Migrate from oui to oui-data
* Add port scan action to device management
* Show IP address and open ports in device details
* Create quicklinks for web ports found by port scan
* Call ping.exe directly on Windows instead of using process.env (compact mode)
* Update @all-smart/all-smart-tools to 1.0.16
* Fix adapter crash when port scan runs on an offline device (#63)
* Use default port list if port list in configuration is missing or empty
* Fix sendTo commands (wake/wol, ping, getMac, addDevice, deleteDevice, updateDevice) being ignored (#71)
* Fix "Wake-on-LAN with IP" sending packets to localhost (#71)
* Wake-on-LAN: also send to the broadcast address of the device subnet, log sent packets, no endless retries on errors
* Add sendTo command portScan
* Add Blockly blocks for ping, port scan and Wake-on-LAN
* Add Blockly block to select a device found by net-tools
* Add extended detection for devices that do not answer pings while sleeping (e.g. iPhone)
* Fix changed device settings (Wake-on-LAN with IP) not being applied until restart
* Add service monitoring via TCP ping for multiple ports per device, with interval and tolerance per port
* Device settings dialog uses the available width (multi-column layout)
* Add latency (ping, min, max, avg) and packet loss per device, with configurable packets per ping

desc.en: This adapter cyclic polls configured IPs, can send wake-on-lan packages and scan for open ports.
desc.de: Dieser Adapter fragt zyklisch konfigurierte IPs ab, kann Wake-on-Lan-Pakete senden und nach offenen Ports suchen.
desc.ru: Этот адаптер циклически опрашивает настроенные IP-адреса, может отправлять пакеты пробуждения по локальной сети и сканировать открытые порты.
desc.pt: Este adaptador pesquisa cíclicamente os IPs configurados, pode enviar pacotes wake-on-lan e procurar portas abertas.
desc.nl: Deze adapter peilt cyclisch geconfigureerde IP's, kan wake-on-lan-pakketten verzenden en scannen op open poorten.
desc.fr: Cet adaptateur interroge cycliquement les adresses IP configurées, peut envoyer des packages wake-on-lan et rechercher les ports ouverts.
desc.it: Questo adattatore esegue il polling ciclico degli IP configurati, può inviare pacchetti wake-on-lan ed eseguire la scansione delle porte aperte.
desc.es: Este adaptador sondea cíclicamente las IP configuradas, puede enviar paquetes Wake-on-LAN y buscar puertos abiertos.
desc.pl: Ten adapter cyklicznie odpytuje skonfigurowane adresy IP, może wysyłać pakiety wake-on-lan i skanować w poszukiwaniu otwartych portów.
desc.uk: Цей адаптер циклічно опитує налаштовані IP-адреси, може надсилати пакети wake-on-lan і сканувати відкриті порти.
desc.zh-cn: 该适配器循环轮询配置的 IP，可以发送 LAN 唤醒包并扫描开放端口。
